page-110dpi: CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING AGENDA Tuesday evening in the council chambers at City Hall. 1. Call to order and roll call of the members present. 2. Approval of the minutes of the previous meeting. 3. Public comment on items not on the agenda today. 4. Consent calendar items approved by a single vote. 5. Report from the finance director on the budget. 6. Resolution authorizing a contract for street repair. 7. Ordinance amending the zoning code for housing. 8. Council member reports and requests for future items. 9. Adjournment of the meeting until the next session.
